name: Marten Coil
tagline: Diagnose the furnace before you diagnose your bank account.
positioning: Marten Coil is the HVAC brain for people who'd rather fix it themselves — error codes, filter timers, and refrigerant logs, minus the $400 service call.

hero.h1: Fix the furnace before it ruins your weekend.
hero.sub: Marten Coil decodes the blinking error light, tracks every filter and capacitor, and tells you what to buy — so you stop paying a stranger $400 to press a reset button.

features.title: Blink-code decoder
features.description: Point at the flashing LED, count the blinks, get plain-English cause and the exact part number. No manual named 'FINAL_v3.pdf' required.

features.title: Filter & maintenance timers
features.description: Automatic reminders for filters, coil cleans, and belt swaps per unit. It nags you so your compressor doesn't die in July.

features.title: Refrigerant log
features.description: Track charge, pressures, and superheat readings over time. Spot the slow leak months before the house turns into a sauna.

features.title: Parts & warranty vault
features.description: Model numbers, receipts, and warranty dates in one place. When the board fries, you already know it's covered.

features.title: Seasonal checklists
features.description: Guided fall and spring tune-ups written for humans, not licensed techs. Fifteen minutes, zero guesswork.

features.title: Ask a real tech
features.description: Stuck at 11pm? Message a vetted HVAC pro and get a straight answer before you rip out a working valve.

testimonials.quote: I stared at three blinking lights for an hour before I found Marten Coil. Turned out to be a $14 flame sensor, not the $2,900 furnace the shop quoted. I cleaned it myself in the driveway.
testimonials.name: Dominic Reyes

testimonials.quote: I flip and rent a handful of units, and I was drowning in filter dates and warranty PDFs. Now every system has a page. My tenants text less, which is the whole point.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

testimonials.quote: I run HVAC on the side for neighbors. The refrigerant log alone got me a repeat customer who saw the leak coming a season out. Feels illegal how simple it is.
testimonials.name: Marcus Tillett

pricing.blurb: For the person who owns exactly one furnace and one strong opinion.
Furnace, AC, mini-splits, that mystery box in the crawlspace.
For landlords and side-hustlers running way too many units.

homepage.footerBlurb: Marten Coil is HVAC software for people who read the manual. Decode it, log it, fix it — and keep the service fee.
